clauses.reason: Terminated by its own terms. The order amends EO 8827 so that Edwards is exempt from compulsory retirement for "a period of one year ending October 31, 1942" (the held sentence reads "a period of one year ending October 31, 1942"). The end is recorded as 1942-10-31, inclusive (the exemption runs through that day, per the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on stated end dates); the exclusive reading, under which the exemption ends when that day begins, is the alternative. The sentence replaces the earlier period, which it quotes as "for a period of one year ending October 31, 1941", so no part of the earlier period outlasts this order. Alternative reading, disclosed: if the amending command is treated as performed on 1941-08-08, the exemption it fixed still ran to the same last day. No later order, statute or regulation held in the packet changes the period; see the order-level checks.

savings.reason: The extension of EO 8827's period is the order's only effect, and it was exhausted when the period ended. Service performed and pay earned during the extended exemption are accrued effects; any annuity or retirement-credit consequence flows from the retirement statutes, not from this order (type rule TR-RETIREMENT-EXEMPTION, exceptions_savings: state transferred_or_accrued). The amended order, EO 8827, ended on the same day.
